items.headline: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.25%, maintains neutral stance
items.summary: The Monetary Policy Committee unanimously decided to keep the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% with a neutral stance. Consequently, the standing deposit facility rate remains at 5% and the marginal standing facility rate and the Bank Rate at 5.50%.

items.headline: RBI projects CPI inflation at 4.6% and real GDP growth at 6.9% for current fiscal year
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India projects CPI inflation for the current financial year at 4.6% and real GDP growth at 6.9%.

items.headline: RBI Governor highlights elevated energy prices and El Niño as upside risks to inflation
items.summary: Governor Sanjay Malhotra highlighted persistently elevated energy prices due to the West Asia conflict and possible El Niño conditions as upside risks to inflation.

items.headline: RBI actively intervened in foreign exchange market, selling $8-15 billion to support rupee
items.summary: In the past week, the RBI actively intervened in the foreign exchange market, selling an estimated $8 billion to $15 billion to support the rupee.

items.headline: New RBI directions reshape customer liability rules for electronic banking fraud
items.summary: New RBI directions for 2026 have reshaped customer liability rules for electronic banking fraud, introducing revised liability rules and faster resolution timelines.

items.headline: India's retail inflation anticipated to accelerate to 4.88% in August 2026
items.summary: India's headline retail inflation is anticipated to accelerate to 4.88% in August 2026, an increase from 4.44% in July, driven primarily by persistent food-price pressures and rising fuel inflation.

items.headline: Defence Acquisition Council approves ₹1.10 lakh crore procurement with 98% indigenous sourcing
items.summary: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) has approved defence procurement proposals totaling approximately ₹1.10 lakh crore for the Indian armed forces, with around 98% expected to be sourced domestically.

items.headline: Union Consumer Affairs Ministry notifies Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026
items.summary: The Union Consumer Affairs Ministry has notified the Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026, establishing IST as the sole official time reference for India.

items.headline: India proposes Telecommunications Rules 2026 with new foreign investment requirements
items.summary: India has proposed the Telecommunications (Television, Radio and Associated Services) Rules 2026, which introduce new requirements for foreign investment, equity ownership, and cross-holdings in the broadcasting sector.

items.headline: Indian stock market opens lower amid global concerns, Nifty below 24750
items.summary: Indian benchmark indices, the Sensex and Nifty 50, opened lower, extending a decline from the previous session, amid persistent selling in large-cap stocks, elevated crude oil prices, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.

items.headline: Wall Street indices close in the red due to profit-booking and cautious investor positioning
items.summary: Wall Street indices closed in the red overnight, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average falling 0.51% and the NASDAQ Composite dipping 0.29%.

items.headline: US-Iran tensions and elevated crude oil prices near $97 per barrel impact global sentiment
items.summary: US-Iran tensions and elevated crude oil prices, with Brent crude hovering near $97 per barrel, are significant concerns impacting investor sentiment globally and domestically.

items.headline: FIIs were net buyers, acquiring equities worth ₹280.13 crore on September 7, 2026
items.summary: Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, acquiring equities worth ₹280.13 crore on September 7, 2026.

items.headline: Nifty 50 companies record approximately 18% year-on-year PAT growth in Q1 FY27
items.summary: The Q1 FY27 earnings season has provided a positive fundamental backdrop, with Nifty 50 companies recording approximately 18% year-on-year growth in profit after tax.

items.headline: Behari Lal Engineering reports 24% year-on-year rise in Q1FY27 net profit to ₹191.94 million
items.summary: Behari Lal Engineering reported a 24% year-on-year rise in Q1FY27 net profit to ₹191.94 million, with revenue increasing by 18% to ₹1,516.74 million.

items.headline: Shiprocket's consolidated net loss narrows to ₹13.7 crore in Q1 FY27
items.summary: The e-commerce logistics enablement platform Shiprocket's consolidated net loss for Q1 narrowed to ₹13.7 crore from ₹18 crore year-on-year.

items.headline: Maruti Interior Products and SRU Steels scheduled to announce results today
items.summary: Maruti Interior Products and SRU Steels are scheduled to announce their quarterly/audited results today.

items.headline: Nifty Realty, Nifty IT, and Nifty Financial Services sectors generally underperform
items.summary: On Tuesday, the Nifty Realty, Nifty IT, and Nifty Financial Services sectors generally exhibited weaker performance.

items.headline: Nifty Metal and Nifty Chemical indices show outperformance
items.summary: In contrast to underperforming sectors, the Nifty Metal and Nifty Chemical indices showed stronger performance.

items.headline: Power and telecommunication sectors witness buying interest, realty and O&G experience selling
items.summary: The power and telecommunication sectors witnessed buying interest, while the realty and oil & gas sectors experienced selling pressure.

items.headline: Defence stocks rally following government's approval of military procurement proposals
items.summary: Defence stocks, including BEL, HAL, and BEML, rallied following the government's approval of significant military procurement proposals.

items.headline: TVS Holdings is on the ex-date for a 46:1 bonus issue
items.summary: TVS Holdings is on the ex-date for a 46:1 bonus issue.

items.headline: Garuda Construction & Engineering subsidiary signs MoU for Jeddah tower project
items.summary: Garuda Construction & Engineering's subsidiary, Dream City Builders, signed an MoU for the Jeddah tower project, a 93-storey structure with an estimated revenue potential of ₹1,800 crore.

items.headline: PVR Inox stock drops after internal investigation into suspected payments concludes
items.summary: PVR Inox saw its stock drop after an internal investigation into suspected ₹200 crore payments concluded with no evidence of kickbacks, though an executive resigned.

items.headline: Anupam Rasayan acquires 0.73% stake in subsidiary Tanfac Industries for ₹60.88 crore
items.summary: Anupam Rasayan acquired a 0.73% stake in its subsidiary, Tanfac Industries, for ₹60.88 crore through a preferential issue.

items.headline: Corporate Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 proposes significant overhaul to streamline merger approvals
items.summary: The Corporate Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, proposes a significant overhaul of corporate statutes, aiming to streamline merger approvals.

items.headline: RBI decision to allow Indian banks to finance acquisitions set to impact M&A space
items.summary: The RBI's decision to allow Indian banks to finance acquisitions for the first time, effective July 1, 2026, is set to impact the M&A space.

items.headline: Several companies declare dividends with an ex-date of September 8, 2026
items.summary: Companies including APL Apollo Tubes (₹8.5/share final), BLS E-Services (₹0.5/share final), and Globus Spirits Ltd have dividends with an ex-date of September 8, 2026.

items.summary: Shriram Finance, HCL Technologies, and Tech Mahindra were identified as the top losers among Nifty50 stocks.

items.summary: BEL, Adani Ports, Eternal, and Tata Steel were listed as top gainers on the Sensex.

content.outlook: Indian equities closed lower across key benchmarks, with NIFTY 50 and SENSEX shedding around half a percent amid negative market breadth. Financial Services witnessed the sharpest decline, while defensive sectors like Pharma and FMCG showed resilience. The low VIX suggests subdued volatility expectations despite the recent dip.
keyTakeaways: NIFTY 50 and SENSEX both closed down approximately 0.5%.
Market breadth was negative with 21 advances against 37 declines.
Pharma (+0.75%) and FMCG (+0.74%) were the top performing sectors.
NIFTY FIN SERVICE (-0.91%) was the weakest sectoral performer.
Top individual losers included BPCL, ICICIBANK, and AXISBANK.
